map.title: Detailed coastline map
map.statusNote: Zone colours show patrol status; current model risk is shown above, and flags on site take priority.
map.modelStatusNote: The circle shows current model risk; check conditions on site.
map.region: Interactive map of the Brighton and Hove coastline
map.unguardedDetail: Active supervision is not guaranteed along the yellow line. Check the flags on site.
map.patrolActive: Within RNLI patrol hours. Swim only between the red-and-yellow flags on site.
map.patrolInactive: Patrol is not active at this time; treat this as an unpatrolled section of coast.
map.patrolUnknown: No verified patrol schedule is available for this date; check on site.
map.groyne: Groyne {number} – do not swim directly beside it
map.westPierDetail: Pier structure and local currents – do not swim near it.
map.palacePierDetail: Pier structure and local currents – do not swim under or beside it.
map.marinaDetail: Boat traffic area – not suitable for swimming.
map.incidentDetail: {value} share of serious and non-life-threatening incidents recorded at patrolled locations in 2022. This is not an individual accident point.
map.modelTooltip: Sampling location for waves, water temperature and sea-level model data.
map.modelOnly: This location currently shows model conditions only. Detailed lifeguard zones, hazards and official water quality are added separately as verified data becomes available.
map.footnote: RNLI beach strips appear as areas only during active patrol hours; otherwise a dot marks the post. Daily flag positions may change. The incident layer is hidden by default; the red layer highlights both piers, the marina entrance and the {count} groynes currently mapped in OpenStreetMap.

outlook.shoreEstimate: Estimated direction from shore to water: {bearing}° · checked {date}.
outlook.limitedNote: Shoreline orientation is not mapped here. Check locally whether the wind blows out to sea.
outlook.title: Calmest two-hour window
outlook.empty: No suitable two-hour daylight window found in the available forecast.
outlook.reason: Up to {wave} m waves · {gusts} gusts · no offshore wind indicated
outlook.scope: Wind and wave outlook only. Check water quality, local currents and beach flags before entering.
outlook.staleText: Fresh conditions are unavailable. Any retained readings are from the last successful update; no recommendation is made.
outlook.waterText: The saved official record contains a poor annual classification or an increased pollution risk. Check the latest notice before planning a swim.
outlook.windTitle: Check the wind direction on site.
outlook.windText: The wind direction relative to this coast or the wind speed is unknown. Low waves alone do not establish favourable conditions.
outlook.waterUnknown: Current water quality is not confirmed.
outlook.normal: No increased risk in the saved record; this is not a live clearance.
outlook.elevated: Increased risk in the saved record; check the latest notice.
outlook.partial: One data source is unavailable. Only the available readings are shown.

contact.title: Send a message
contact.intro: Have an idea, spotted a problem, or want to say hello?
contact.name: Name (optional)
contact.hint: 10–5,000 characters. Your email lets Gergely reply to you.
contact.success: Thank you! Your message has been submitted.
contact.privacy: Your message and email will be forwarded to Gergely via Resend.
contact.invalid: Check your email and enter a message of 10–5,000 characters.
contact.unavailable: We couldn’t send your message. Your text is still here — please try again later.
contact.rateLimit: Too many attempts. Please wait 10 minutes before trying again.

windAdvice.noDataHelp: No wind readings are available for this time. Refresh the forecast; the direction and strength cannot be assessed yet.
windAdvice.incompleteTitle: Wind strength alone cannot assess this swim.
windAdvice.belowThreshold: Below the app’s wind warning thresholds. This does not rule out waves or currents.
windAdvice.offshore: Even lighter offshore wind can carry you away from your exit. Keep close to shore and keep your exit in sight.
windAdvice.dangerOffshore: Offshore wind reaches the app’s avoid-swimming threshold: returning to shore may be difficult.
windAdvice.cautionGusts: Gusts reach the app’s caution threshold. Sudden increases in wind can make swimming and returning harder.
windAdvice.dangerGusts: Gusts reach the app’s avoid-swimming threshold, whatever the wind direction.
windAdvice.missingShore: We have wind data, but cannot relate it to this shoreline. A flag streaming from land towards water indicates offshore wind; returning may be harder even if the water looks flat.
windAdvice.missingDirection: The forecast wind direction is missing. Watch a flag: land to water means offshore; along the beach means you may drift away from your exit.
windAdvice.missingSpeed: Wind speed or gust data is missing. Direction alone cannot tell us how demanding the swim may be.
windAdvice.stale: Fresh wind data is unavailable. Refresh before using the wind assessment.
windAdvice.details: How much does the wind matter?
windAdvice.onshore: Wind towards shore can build waves and breaking surf. It is not automatically safer.
windAdvice.alongshore: Wind along the shore can move you away from your entry point. Keep a fixed landmark and your exit in sight.
windAdvice.unknownDirection: Compare a flag with the shoreline: towards the water, towards land, or along the beach. Ask the lifeguard if unsure.
windAdvice.offshoreThreshold: Offshore: caution at any speed; swimming not recommended from {value} sustained wind.
windAdvice.gustThreshold: Gusts: caution from {caution}; swimming not recommended from {danger}, in any direction.
windAdvice.limits: These are app warning thresholds, not safe limits. The effect also depends on exposure, waves, currents and your ability. Local flags take priority.
windAdvice.directionEstimate: Shore-relative direction is an estimate; bays and shelter can change the wind at your entry point.

lakeDecision.unresolved: The earlier warning needs an update.
lakeDecision.unresolvedAction: Confirm whether the earlier adverse signal still applies before entering. A failed refresh does not mean it has cleared.
lakeDecision.previousConcern: An earlier assigned report contained an adverse signal; its current validity is not confirmed.
lakeDecision.stationWind: An assigned official station reports stronger wind. This is a station reading, not a confirmed measurement at your entry point.
lakeDecision.label: Lake swimming · evidence and limits
lakeDecision.caution: There is a reason to be cautious.
lakeDecision.limited: No strong wind in the forecast.
lakeDecision.insufficient: There is not enough evidence to plan this swim.
lakeDecision.avoidAction: Stay out until the adverse signal has cleared and fresh information confirms the change.
lakeDecision.cautionAction: Resolve the warning before entering. If it applies to your bathing area, postpone the swim.
lakeDecision.limitedAction: Next, check bathing restrictions, waves and water temperature at your entry point. If these suit your preparation, use a designated bathing area, stay close to your exit and swim with someone. This is a wind assessment, not swimming clearance.
lakeDecision.insufficientAction: Wait for fresh weather data or ask the bathing-area operator about current conditions before deciding.
lakeDecision.lowerWind: Forecast wind and gusts are below the app’s wind caution threshold.
lakeDecision.stormClear: The fresh official storm report shows no warning in the covered area.
lakeDecision.thunder: Thunderstorms are forecast for this time.
lakeDecision.gustDanger: Gusts reach the app’s avoid-swimming threshold.
lakeDecision.gustCaution: Wind reaches the app’s caution threshold.
lakeDecision.closure: The saved record marks this bathing site closed.
lakeDecision.qualityConcern: The saved record for this site contains a water-quality concern.
lakeDecision.failedSample: The latest available official sample for this site failed; check for a newer result or notice.
lakeDecision.stormDanger: A fresh level-II storm warning covers this area.
lakeDecision.stormCaution: A fresh storm warning covers this area.
lakeDecision.regionalStorm: A storm warning is reported in part of the lake. Its applicability to this beach is not established; identify your basin before entering.
lakeDecision.localWater: Local waves, currents, water temperature and current water quality are not established by this weather assessment. Annual ratings and nearby stations do not resolve this.
lakeDecision.windMissing: Wind speed or gust data is missing.
lakeDecision.weatherMissing: The weather-condition forecast is missing, so thunderstorms cannot be checked.
lakeDecision.futureWarnings: Current official warnings and samples do not establish conditions at this future time.
lakeDecision.warningsUnknown: No fresh storm-warning coverage is confirmed for this bathing area.

timeline.nightText: In darkness it is harder to navigate and spot a swimmer in difficulty. Choose a daylight swim instead.
